answer: Vesting time-lock: mining rewards are not paid out at once but vest linearly over 40 epochs, and any key caught in a sybil ring forfeits everything still unvested. The farm operator pays: each fake must keep answering for weeks before its quill earns anything spendable, so idle capital and fees grow per identity. Failure case: a fleet that cashes out early hits a canyon of locked balance, and slashing one key in the orchard of linked wallets burns the unvested pile of all of them.
